info.title: Storyworld Engine application API
info.description: Contract-first public application API per canonical part 04 section 14.1-14.2 (F1 contract pack, GATE-0003 scope). Conventions: 202 Accepted plus operation id for long-running work; Idempotency-Key on all externally initiated mutations; If-Match/expected-version concurrency; cursor pagination with stable ordering; RFC 9457 Problem Details errors; SSE/WebSocket job and review subscriptions. Studio and any BFF use only these commands (ADR-0002). Payload shapes marked x-storyworld-contract-schema are owned by the contract-pack JSON Schemas (tag: URIs); this document owns resources, verbs, and conventions. Authored as strict JSON per DEC-0005; YAML derivative may be generated for external tooling.
info.x-storyworld-authority: This contract grants nothing; authority per charter authority-matrix and approval taxonomy.
